title: Marketplace vetting
subtitle: Review third-party agents before they are listed, and delist them when they stop meeting the bar. Automated checks inform the review; they never replace it.

queue.emptyDescription: New agent versions appear here as soon as a publisher submits them.

manifest.shape.title: Manifest structure
manifest.shape.fail: The manifest is malformed. See the details below.

manifest.limits.title: Run limits
manifest.limits.pass: Limits are within the recommended range.
manifest.limits.warn: A limit is above the recommended ceiling.

manifest.prompt.title: System prompt
manifest.prompt.fail: A system prompt is only allowed for built-in agents.

scopes.known.title: Known scopes
scopes.known.fail: The manifest requests scopes that do not exist.

scopes.risk.title: High-risk scopes
scopes.risk.warn: High-risk scopes need a written justification.

scopes.coherence.title: Scope coherence
scopes.coherence.warn: Some scopes look unnecessary or unusable.

outbound.endpoint.title: Endpoint
outbound.endpoint.pass: A public https endpoint on port 443.
outbound.endpoint.warn: A built-in agent should not have an endpoint.
outbound.endpoint.fail: The endpoint is missing or unsafe.

outbound.host.title: Endpoint host
outbound.host.warn: The host needs a closer look (look-alike or shared host).

outbound.dns.title: DNS resolution
outbound.dns.warn: DNS was not checked for this report.
outbound.dns.fail: The host does not resolve, or resolves to a private address.

outbound.declared.title: Declared processors
outbound.declared.warn: Contact data is requested but no processors were declared.
outbound.declared.fail: The declared domain list is invalid.

data.exposure.title: Data exposure
data.exposure.pass: No personal contact data leaves Vireek.
data.exposure.warn: Personal contact data (phone, email, address) leaves Vireek.

data.messaging.title: Customer messaging
data.messaging.warn: The agent can propose SMS messages to customers.

identity.publisher.title: Publisher identity
identity.publisher.fail: A third-party name uses the Vireek brand.

identity.lookalike.title: Name similarity
identity.lookalike.warn: The name is identical or very close to another agent.

review.noReport: No automated checks have been run for this version yet.
review.selfAttested: Declared outbound domains are self-attested by the publisher and are not enforced. A passing report is an input to your review, not a certification.
review.noteRequired: Add a note of at least 5 characters.
review.blockedTitle: Approval is blocked until these are resolved
review.decisionHelp: Required to reject or request changes. Visible to the publisher.

blockers.self_review: You cannot review your own agent.
blockers.report_manifest_mismatch: The report is for a different manifest. Run the checks again.
blockers.report_endpoint_mismatch: The endpoint changed since the report. Run the checks again.
blockers.report_stale: The report is older than 14 days. Run the checks again.
blockers.checklist_failed: A checklist item is marked as failed.
blockers.checklist_incomplete: Some checklist items are not answered yet.

listed.warning: Delisting removes the agent from the marketplace, revokes every install immediately and stops queued runs. Reinstating later requires a new version to pass vetting again.
listed.internalHelp: For staff only. Not shown to the publisher or customers.
listed.publisherMessageHelp: Shown to the publisher. Do not include customer data.
listed.emptyDescription: Published, suspended and delisted agents appear here.

history.emptyDescription: Delisting and reinstatement events are recorded here permanently.

errors.forbidden: Only Vireek staff can use this page.
errors.blocked: Approval is blocked. See the list above.
errors.notFound: That item no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

publisher_identity.label: Publisher identity verified
publisher_identity.hint: Company name, registration and a working contact were confirmed out of band.

security_contact.label: Security contact
security_contact.hint: The publisher gave a monitored address for vulnerability reports.

endpoint_control.label: Endpoint ownership
endpoint_control.hint: The publisher demonstrably controls the endpoint domain.

signature_verification.label: Signature verification
signature_verification.hint: In a test run the agent verified the HMAC signature and rejected a stale timestamp.

scopes_justified.label: Scopes justified
scopes_justified.hint: Each requested scope has a stated, proportionate reason.

pii_minimisation.label: Personal data minimised
pii_minimisation.hint: Contact data is needed for the agent's purpose and is not kept longer than necessary.

subprocessors_match.label: Processors match disclosures
subprocessors_match.hint: Declared outbound domains match the publisher's privacy information. Not applicable if none are declared.

dpa_in_place.label: Data processing agreement
dpa_in_place.hint: A data processing agreement is in place for this high-risk agent.

sandbox_run_reviewed.label: Sandbox run reviewed
sandbox_run_reviewed.hint: A sample run in a test account stayed within the granted scopes.

sms_compliance.label: SMS compliance
sms_compliance.hint: A2P registration, opt-out handling and quiet hours were reviewed.

pricing_terms_clear.label: Pricing is clear
pricing_terms_clear.hint: Price, billing period and platform fee are stated accurately.

delisting_terms_ack.label: Delisting terms acknowledged
delisting_terms_ack.hint: The publisher accepted the delisting terms in docs/marketplace/vetting.md.
